sessions.formCue: Neutral hinge held well in S1 — this session: strict row, no torso twist, elbow to the hip.
sessions.notes: Carries the 1-arm DB row skipped in S2. Load flat, finisher Zone 2, pec-safe. NEW: correctives block from 7/29 squat film (early hinge + torso pitch) — see Movement Profile.

blocks.detail: Knee-to-wall ankle test both sides (note inches, tell me in session notes) + 2x30s/side wall ankle rocks + 2x10 thoracic extensions over foam roller

blocks.name: 1-arm DB row
blocks.detail: 3 sets × 10/side — FILM the top set, side-on

blocks.name: Back extension + band pull-aparts

sessions.formCue: Engine day. Smooth is fast — hold the split, don't redline the first round.
sessions.notes: First engine day of the new mix (HWPO-style pacing). Pec-safe. Intervals, not a hero WOD.

blocks.name: Correctives warm-up
blocks.detail: Wall ankle rocks 2x30s/side + t-spine extensions 2x10 + 3 min easy row

blocks.name: Row intervals
blocks.detail: 5 rounds: 250m row hard-but-repeatable + 12 KB swings (12kg) + 10 goblet squats. Rest 1:1. FILM round 3, side-on.

blocks.name: Farmer carry finisher
blocks.detail: 4 x 40yd heavy carry (whatever handles you have), walk tall, rest 60s

sessions.formCue: From your squat film: chest tall, break knees and hips together, sit between your feet.
sessions.notes: Hypertrophy lower. Tempo work grooves the squat pattern from Movement Profile. Adjusted 7/30: you're going lighter to protect the pec — so the baseline is now BY FEEL, not a fixed 221. Trap-bar is pec-safe (arms hang, no pec stretch/load) but you set the ceiling.

blocks.name: Correctives warm-up
blocks.detail: Ankle rocks 2x30s/side + t-spine ext 2x10

blocks.name: Trap-bar deadlift
blocks.detail: Work UP over 3 sets of 8 (e.g. 160 → 180 → 200, by feel), then one last set of 8 at RPE 8-9 — heavy but crisp, stop instantly if the pec says anything. Whatever that weight is, that's our baseline.

blocks.name: Goblet squat — 3s down, 1s pause
blocks.detail: 3 x 10, light KB. FILM set 3 side-on — this is the pattern check.

blocks.name: Back extension + band pull-aparts
blocks.detail: 3 rounds: 12 + 15

sessions.formCue: Mile TT: even splits. Go out at a pace you can hold, negative-split the back half.
sessions.notes: Baseline day: mile run time trial + 500m row TT (rested). These anchor engine pacing + future percentage prescriptions.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.detail: Ankle rocks + t-spine ext + 5 min build-up jog with strides

blocks.name: 1-mile run — TIME TRIAL
blocks.detail: Enter total minutes. Even pacing; this is a baseline, not a death march

blocks.name: 500m row — TIME TRIAL
blocks.detail: Full rest after the mile (10+ min), then one hard 500. Enter time

sessions.formCue: Row: strict, no torso twist, elbow to the hip. Pick a bell that makes 10 hard.
sessions.notes: Hyp upper-pull, pec-safe (no pressing/dips/rings). Carries the STILL-OWED row film and knee-to-wall ankle numbers. Flexibility screen closes the S3-S7 baseline battery.

blocks.name: Correctives + ankle screen (OWED from S3)
blocks.detail: Knee-to-wall test both sides — foot flat, knee to wall, farthest toe distance that still touches. Enter inches below. Then ankle rocks 2x30s/side + t-spine ext 2x10.

blocks.name: 1-arm DB row — heavier
blocks.detail: 4 x 10/side @ 0-3 RIR. You have up to 60 lb on the rack — 25 was too light (30 reps last time). FILM the top set, side-on (owed since S2).

blocks.name: Pull-ups (band-assist as needed)
blocks.detail: 4 sets to 2-3 reps shy of failure. Green/red band under a foot if needed; slow 3s lowers if even that's too much.

blocks.name: Back extension + band pull-aparts
blocks.detail: 3 rounds: 12 + 15 on the Hyper Pro

blocks.name: Flexibility screen (baseline battery)
blocks.detail: Honest baseline, no warm-up tricks. Toe touch: inches from floor (0 = touching, negative = past). Shoulder wall: arms overhead flat to wall, 1 = yes / 0 = no. Squat hold: seconds held, heels down.

sessions.formCue: For-time pieces score CALORIES now — the rower counts them for you. Smooth is fast.
sessions.notes: Engine intervals, pec-safe. New scoring convention: for-time = calories.

blocks.name: Correctives warm-up
blocks.detail: Ankle rocks 2x30s/side + t-spine ext 2x10

blocks.name: Row intervals — for calories
blocks.detail: 5 rounds: 3 min row for MAX CALORIES + 10 goblet squats + 10 KB swings between rounds. Enter TOTAL calories across all 5. Rest 90s between rounds. FILM round 3 side-on.

blocks.name: Farmer carry
blocks.detail: 4 x 40yd heavy, walk tall, rest 60s

sessions.formCue: Control the way down about 3 seconds, drive up fast. Full depth beats extra weight.
sessions.notes: HYP A. Stimulus: heavy-ish lower + back. 55-70 min. SCALE TEST: if set 1 of belt squat doesn't leave 1-2 reps in the tank at the target reps, the load is wrong — fix it on set 2. Compounds 1-3 RIR, isolations 0-1 RIR. Score = loads. PEC GATE: nothing here loads the pec. Finishing superset keeps every muscle at 2x/week without adding session time.

blocks.name: Correctives warm-up
blocks.detail: Ankle rocks 2x30s/side, t-spine extensions 2x10, band pull-aparts 2x15. Then 2 ramp sets on the first lift.

blocks.name: Trap-bar deadlift
blocks.detail: 4 x 6-8 @ 2 RIR. Work up to a hard-but-crisp top set, then hold that load. Rest 2-3 min — rest long enough that reps don't collapse. Progress: add reps to 8 across all sets, then add load. FILM set 3 side-on.

blocks.name: Belt squat (Hyper Pro)
blocks.detail: 3 x 10-12 @ 1-2 RIR. Full depth, knees track over toes. Rest 2 min. Pec-free loaded squatting.

blocks.name: Leg extension (leg developer)
blocks.detail: 3 x 12-15 @ 0-1 RIR, last set to failure. Rest 60-90s. This is the rectus femoris work squats do NOT cover — don't skip it.

blocks.name: Weighted pull-up / chin-up
blocks.detail: 4 x 6-8 @ 2 RIR. Add load once you clear 8 clean. Full hang each rep. Rest 2 min.

blocks.name: Chest-supported incline DB row
blocks.detail: 3 x 10-12 @ 1 RIR. Chest stays on the bench, full stretch at the bottom. Rest 90s.

blocks.name: DB lateral raise
blocks.detail: 3 x 12-15 @ 0-1 RIR. Lean away slightly. Last set: partials past failure. Rest 60s.

blocks.name: Ring hanging leg raise
blocks.detail: 3 x 10-12, controlled down. Rest 60s.

blocks.name: Superset: calf raise + overhead triceps extension
blocks.detail: 3 rounds, back to back, minimal rest between the pair, 90s after each round. Calf raise 12-15 off a plate (full stretch, 1s pause at the bottom) THEN overhead DB/EZ extension 10-12 @ 0-1 RIR (full stretch behind the head). Log the calf load here; note the triceps load in the wrap-up.

sessions.formCue: Hold the split. If it slips more than 3 seconds, you went out too hot.
sessions.notes: ENGINE, placed the day AFTER heavy legs on purpose — never before. Stimulus: hard repeatable intervals, ~18 min of work. SCALE TEST: pick a pace you can HOLD for all 5 — if round 4 falls apart, you paced it wrong, not trained it wrong. Score = TOTAL calories. Rower/carry only: no pressing, no dips (pec gate).

blocks.name: Correctives warm-up
blocks.detail: Ankle rocks 2x30s/side, t-spine extensions 2x10, band pull-aparts 2x15. Then 2 ramp sets on the first lift.

blocks.name: Row intervals — max calories
blocks.detail: 5 rounds: row 3 min HARD for calories, rest 90s. Enter TOTAL calories across all 5 rounds. Target: rounds 1 and 5 within 3 cal of each other. FILM round 2 side-on for the catch.

blocks.name: Farmer carry
blocks.detail: 4 x 40yd heavy, tall posture, rest 60s. Grip and trunk — no shoulder loading.

blocks.name: Back extension (Hyper Pro)
blocks.detail: 3 x 12-15, slow, squeeze at the top. Rest 60s.

sessions.formCue: On the RDL: push the hips back, feel the hamstrings load. Stop when your back would round, not when the bar hits the floor.
sessions.notes: HYP B. Stimulus: hinge + knee flexion + arms. 55-70 min. SCALE TEST: on the leg curl, the last 2 reps of set 3 should be genuinely hard. Compounds 1-3 RIR, isolations 0-1 RIR. Score = loads. Overhead triceps work is deliberate — it grows the long head ~1.5x what pushdowns do, and it's pec-safe. Finishing superset keeps every muscle at 2x/week without adding session time.

blocks.name: Correctives warm-up
blocks.detail: Ankle rocks 2x30s/side, t-spine extensions 2x10, band pull-aparts 2x15. Then 2 ramp sets on the first lift.

blocks.name: Barbell RDL
blocks.detail: 4 x 8-10 @ 2 RIR. Slow 3s lowering, hips back, soft knees. Rest 2-3 min. Progress reps to 10 before adding load. FILM set 3 side-on.

blocks.name: Leg curl (leg developer)
blocks.detail: 3 x 10-12 @ 0-1 RIR. This covers the hamstring head RDLs miss — non-optional. Rest 90s.

blocks.name: Bulgarian split squat
blocks.detail: 3 x 10-12 per leg @ 1-2 RIR. Front foot flat, long stride, deep. DBs at your sides. Rest 90s between legs.

blocks.name: TRX / ring row
blocks.detail: 3 x 12-15 @ 1 RIR. Feet forward to make it harder. Full protraction at the bottom, squeeze at the top. Rest 90s.

blocks.name: Overhead DB or EZ triceps extension
blocks.detail: 3 x 10-12 @ 0-1 RIR. Seated, elbows in, full stretch behind the head. Rest 60-90s. Best-evidenced triceps pick there is.

blocks.name: Incline DB curl
blocks.detail: 3 x 10-12 @ 0-1 RIR. Bench at 45deg, arms hanging behind you, full stretch. Rest 60s.

blocks.name: Standing calf raise
blocks.detail: 3 x 12-15 off a plate, full stretch at the bottom, pause 1s. Last set: bottom-half partials to failure. Rest 60s.

blocks.name: Superset: lateral raise + ab wheel
blocks.detail: 3 rounds, back to back, 90s after each round. DB lateral raise 12-15 @ 0-1 RIR (lean away slightly, partials past failure on the last set) THEN ab wheel or ring fallout 8-12 (ribs down, slow). Log the lateral raise load here.

sessions.formCue: Same lifts as Session 9. Beat last time by reps or load — that is the whole job today.
sessions.notes: HYP A repeat, week 2 of the block. PROGRESSION: hit the top of each rep range at the SAME load you used in s9, then add load next time. One extra set on lateral raises (volume ramp). Compare to s9 — the app shows your logged numbers. Score = loads. Finishing superset keeps every muscle at 2x/week without adding session time.

blocks.name: Correctives warm-up
blocks.detail: Ankle rocks 2x30s/side, t-spine extensions 2x10, band pull-aparts 2x15. Then 2 ramp sets on the first lift.

blocks.name: Trap-bar deadlift
blocks.detail: 4 x 6-8 @ 2 RIR. Match or beat s9 — same load for more reps, or more load. Rest 2-3 min.

blocks.name: Belt squat (Hyper Pro)
blocks.detail: 3 x 10-12 @ 1-2 RIR. Beat s9's reps at the same load. Rest 2 min.

blocks.name: Leg extension (leg developer)
blocks.detail: 3 x 12-15 @ 0-1 RIR, last set to failure. Rest 60-90s.

blocks.name: Weighted pull-up / chin-up
blocks.detail: 4 x 6-8 @ 2 RIR. Rest 2 min. FILM set 2 — checking the bottom position.

blocks.name: Chest-supported incline DB row
blocks.detail: 3 x 10-12 @ 1 RIR. Rest 90s.

blocks.name: DB lateral raise
blocks.detail: 4 x 12-15 @ 0-1 RIR (one more set than s9). Rest 60s.

blocks.name: Superset: calf raise + overhead triceps extension
blocks.detail: 3 rounds, back to back, minimal rest between the pair, 90s after each round. Calf raise 12-15 off a plate (full stretch, 1s pause at the bottom) THEN overhead DB/EZ extension 10-12 @ 0-1 RIR (full stretch behind the head). Log the calf load here; note the triceps load in the wrap-up. Beat s9 by reps at the same loads.

sessions.formCue: This one is meant to be continuous. Pick a KB you can swing 15 unbroken when fresh.
sessions.notes: ENGINE, after the heavy lower day. Stimulus: 12-15 min continuous couplet, steady pace with limited breaks — not a sprint. SCALE TEST: if you have to break the swings in round 1, the bell is too heavy or the reps too many. Score = TOTAL ROUNDS + reps. Pec-safe: no pressing, no dips.

blocks.name: Correctives warm-up
blocks.detail: Ankle rocks 2x30s/side, t-spine extensions 2x10, band pull-aparts 2x15. Then 2 ramp sets on the first lift.

blocks.name: AMRAP 14 — row / swing / step-up
blocks.detail: As many rounds as possible in 14 min: row 250m + 15 KB swings + 20 box step-ups (10/leg, 20in). Enter ROUNDS completed (count a partial round as a decimal, e.g. 5.5). Keep moving — limited breaks.

blocks.name: Suitcase carry
blocks.detail: 3 x 40yd per side, heavy, tall. Rest 60s.

blocks.name: Ab wheel / ring fallout
blocks.detail: 3 x 8-12, slow, ribs down. Rest 60s.
